about: Pictures and shape facts for every style in the 3D designer's library, for matching a dealer's photos to a style. Made by node tools/make-style-refs.mjs and checked by node tools/check-style-refs.mjs in the 3D designer repository.
pitch_note: Every pitch, height and size here is the library's own number: Barnwright's drawing of the standard building line. They are not a shop's measured numbers. A dealer's real buildings can be steeper or flatter, and a photo can only say roughly how steep a roof is.

drawn_with.look: the Yoder Storage Barns site's light (true colour)

three_quarter.words: From the front corner: the front end on the left, the right long side on the right. The same view the 3D designer opens on.

end.words: Straight at the front end, from a little above the floor. The roof's shape and pitch can be measured on it: the right long side is on the right.

walls_legend.F: The front end: the short end on the left in the corner picture, and the end the end picture looks at.
walls_legend.B: The back end: the other short end, not seen in either picture.
walls_legend.R: The right long side: the long side on the right in the corner picture. Side-door styles have their doors here.
walls_legend.L: The left long side: the other long side, not seen in either picture.
walls_legend.porch: A porch's own walls are named as the porch's back, end, side or angled wall.

sheet.words: Every style's corner picture, 4 across in the order of "order", each labelled with its code.
